description: This file is a Swift source file defining a static enumeration 'OpenClawConfigFile' that manages reading, writing, and monitoring configuration data stored in JSON files. It includes functions for loading configurations, updating gateway settings, toggling browser control, handling agent workspace, managing remote gateway URLs, and performing health checks and audits.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL of the configuration file.

methods.name: stateDirURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the state directory.

methods.name: defaultWorkspaceURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the default workspace.

methods.name: loadDict
methods.description: Loads and parses the configuration dictionary from the JSON file.

methods.name: saveDict
methods.description: Serializes and saves the given dictionary to the configuration JSON file.

methods.name: loadGatewayDict
methods.description: Loads the gateway configuration dictionary.

methods.name: updateGatewayDict
methods.description: Modifies the gateway configuration dictionary through a mutation closure.

methods.name: browserControlEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether browser control is enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: setBrowserControlEnabled
methods.description: Sets the browser control enabled flag in the configuration.

methods.name: agentWorkspace
methods.description: Retrieves the agent workspace setting from the configuration.

methods.name: setAgentWorkspace
methods.description: Sets the agent workspace in the configuration.

methods.name: gatewayPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the remote gateway password from the configuration.

methods.name: gatewayPort
methods.description: Gets the gateway port number from the configuration.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort
methods.description: Gets the remote gateway port number based on the URL.

methods.name: remoteGatewayPort(matchingHost:)
methods.description: Returns the port if the URL's host matches the provided SSH host.

methods.name: setRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Updates the remote gateway URL in the configuration with a specific host and port.

methods.name: clearRemoteGatewayUrl
methods.description: Removes the remote gateway URL from the configuration.

methods.name: hostKey
methods.description: Normalizes a hostname to a key for comparison and storage.

methods.name: parseConfigData
methods.description: Parses raw Data into a dictionary, supporting JSON5 if available.

methods.name: gatewayMode
methods.description: Extracts the gateway mode string from the configuration.

methods.name: configWriteSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Identifies reasons why a configuration write might be suspicious.

methods.name: configAuditLogURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for the config audit logs.

methods.name: configHealthStateURL
methods.description: Generates the URL for the configuration health state logs.

methods.name: readConfigHealthState
methods.description: Reads the current health state information of the configuration.

methods.name: writeConfigHealthState
methods.description: Persists the health state of the configuration.

methods.name: configFingerprint
methods.description: Creates a fingerprint (hash and metadata) for the configuration file.

methods.name: sameFingerprint
methods.description: Compares two fingerprints for equality.

methods.name: observeSuspiciousReasons
methods.description: Determines reasons why the configuration might be suspicious.

methods.name: readConfigFingerprint
methods.description: Reads and computes fingerprint info for a config at a given URL.

methods.name: configTimestampToken
methods.description: Generates a timestamp token string from a timestamp.

methods.name: persistClobberedSnapshot
methods.description: Saves a backup snapshot of a clobbered configuration.

methods.name: observeConfigRead
methods.description: Instruments during config read to log and detect anomalies.

methods.name: appendConfigWriteAudit
methods.description: Appends an audit record for a configuration write.

methods.name: appendConfigObserveAudit
methods.description: Appends an audit record for a configuration observation.
